admin.rerollLeaderHint: Randomly choose the starting leader and update the initial Lady of the Lake holder. Roles stay the same. The same leader may be selected again.
admin.rerollRolesHint: Shuffle the configured roles among all players, replace old identity hints, and ask everyone to view and confirm their new identity. Previously seen information cannot be forgotten; check with the table before proceeding.
admin.openingOnlyHint: Available only at the opening, before the first proposal or Merlin identification. Retracting or rewinding does not reopen these tools.
admin.title: Referee Tools
admin.enableHint: Enabling referee tools lets you unbind players, vote, or propose on their behalf. Every action is logged publicly in red for the whole table to see.
admin.unbindHint: Boot the player from their seat. The seat becomes open for anyone to re-claim and take over the identity with full history.
admin.proposeHint: Pick {size} member(s) for the current leader
admin.retractVotesHint: Before the result is published, clear everyone's cast votes so they can vote again.
admin.retractProposalHint: Cancel this proposal and return to team building for the current leader to propose again.
admin.previousPhaseHint: Restore the previous phase, leader, team and results. Votes or mission cards for that phase must be submitted again. Revealed identities and inspections cannot be forgotten.
admin.startAssassinationHint: End the current discussion or voting and let the Assassin identify Merlin. Hitting Merlin wins for the red team; missing wins for the blue team.

missionSuccess.title: Mission success

missionFail.title: Mission failure
missionFail.description: Reveals a mission with a fail card. Reset to replay.

twoFails.title: Round four · Two fails required

assassination.description: Three successful missions. The assassin chooses a good player to strike.

goodWins.title: Good wins · Assassin missed

evilWins.title: Evil wins · Merlin assassinated
evilWins.description: After three successful missions, killing Merlin gives evil the win.

fiveRejections.title: Evil wins · Five rejections

spectator.title: Spectator
spectator.description: All seats are occupied. Spectators cannot perform player actions.

openSeat.title: Claim an open seat
openSeat.description: Claim the open seat, then reveal that player’s role.

offline.title: Player offline
offline.description: One player is offline with their seat reserved. Toggle it in connection controls.

reconnecting.title: Reconnecting
reconnecting.description: Table actions pause. Restore the connection in the controls to continue.

announcement.title: Team explanation
announcement.description: The leader explains the draft and chooses the speaking direction, then speaks last.

discussion.title: Speaking turns
discussion.description: Each player ends their own turn in seat order.

finalizing.title: Finalize team
finalizing.description: Keep or revise the team, then open voting.

overdue.title: Overdue speech
overdue.description: The speaker can still finish after the reminder expires.

discussion.order: Speak in the chosen direction, with the leader last
discussion.finalizingHint: Keep or change the draft team, then confirm to begin voting.
discussion.rules: Draft a team → leader explains and chooses clockwise (left) or counterclockwise (right) speaking order → discussion, with the leader last → finalize the team → vote.
discussion.timeRules: Each discussion turn lasts {seconds} seconds. The explanation gets half that time, assassination discussion gets 1.5 times, and other actions get 20 seconds. Overtime is advisory; actions never advance automatically.

reroll.rules: Earn 1 per 5 completed games and 1 on daily sign-in (resets at 04:00 UTC+8). Hold up to 2; rewards at capacity are not saved.
reroll.effect: Spend 1 card to redeal the whole table. Your new role will be different. Everyone must confirm again.
reroll.login: Sign in to earn and use reroll cards
reroll.unavailable: Available before confirming your role and the first team proposal only.
